title: Constructibility of the underived finite coefficient/site square
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning that it has a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings, let $a\le b$ be integers, and let $C$ be a cochain complex of etale $A_X$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Suppose that $C^q=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$ and that each $C^q$ is constructible with a global finite partition into constructible locally closed strata on which it is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Put $C_B=C\otimes_{A_X}B_X$, using ordinary termwise sheaf tensor and the $B_X$-action on the second factor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $N_R=\nu_X^*$ for the exact comparison on constant-$R$ modules, for $R=A,B$ [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact], and write $Q$ for localization to the ordinary module derived categories of the two sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules].
Every term of $C_B$ is constructible over $B$, and any finite stratification witnessing constructibility of $C^q$ also witnesses constructibility of $C_B^q$; on an etale trivializing cover with finite $A$-module value $M$, its value is the finite $B$-module $M\otimes_A B$. For any constructible etale $R_X$-module sheaf $F$, where $R=A$ or $B$, $N_RF$ is intrinsically constructible on the pro-etale site [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: each witnessing nonempty finite stratification for $F$ and each etale trivializing cover on its strata give the same stratification and a pro-etale trivializing cover with the same finite module values. If the chosen partition has zero strata (necessarily $X=\varnothing$), replace it by the one-stratum partition consisting of the empty subscheme, with constant zero module; this satisfies the positive-number-of-strata convention on the pro-etale side [def-constructible-stratification]. The four objects $Q(C)$, $Q(C_B)$, $Q(N_AC)$ and $Q(N_BC_B)$ have constructible cohomology, zero outside $[a,b]$, on their respective sites [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. More precisely, $H^q(N_RC')\simeq N_RH^q(C')$ for $(R,C')=(A,C),(B,C_B)$. These assertions do not require flatness of the terms of $C$ or of $B$ over $A$; $C_B$ here is an underived tensor complex, with no claim that it represents a derived scalar extension.

proof.text: Use the already proved source functors in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ScalarExtensionConstructible: constantSheafCompEtaleSheafExtendScalarsIso identifies extension of a constant M with the constant extended module, and etaleSheafExtendScalarsCompUpperStarIso commutes extension with every scheme inverse image. These are uniqueness-of-left-adjoint comparisons, so do not require a presentation, a ringed-site encoding, or flatness. Convert finite-value constructibility with [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] and apply the proved source isConstructibleSheaf_etaleSheafExtendScalars_obj. On any specified stratum and etale object, transport the given model through the etale slice equivalence, apply the two comparisons, then transport back. ModuleCat.finite_extendScalars_obj' makes the extended module finitely generated over the finite ring B, hence a finite set. This proves constructibleCoefficientSheaf with its arbitrary-stratum/model clause.

Convert etale constructibility with [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] and use the already proved forward source theorem ProEtale.isConstructible_comparisonUpperStar_obj. On every stratum its finite-model predicate gives local constancy through [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-local-constancy] and finite stalks through [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-stalks]. For positive-size partitions retain all strata. A zero-size partition forces X empty; use its identity one-stratum partition and the empty covering. This gives intrinsic fixed-coefficient constructibility without passing through the ringed-coefficient encoding.

For the arbitrary specified nonempty partition and cover, its etale cover belongs to the proetale precoverage. Transport each given constant model through the etale slice equivalence. The canonical scheme-pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], followed by comparisonUpperStarConstantSheafIso (uniqueness of the constant-sheaf left adjoint), gives the same constant M on the covering scheme. Transport back through the proetale slice equivalence [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. For an empty input partition the underlying X is empty. Every object of its small site is empty and has the empty covering, hence every module sheaf is zero. Its identity one-stratum partition therefore has constant zero value as asserted. This proves all remaining clauses of constructibleSiteComparison.

For each etale complex, [thm-constructible-serre] proves that the kernel of its outgoing differential and the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted to this kernel are constructible in the source-library predicate. ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift identifies this cokernel with its homology. Convert through [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. The representative comparison [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] identifies it with localized cohomology. ShortComplex.isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂ proves vanishing whenever the middle term is zero. Scalar extension is additive, so preserves the support interval. Apply these facts to C and constructibleCoefficientComplex X phi C.

Exact comparison [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] and Mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso give H^q(N D) isomorphic to N H^q(D) for both D=C and D=C_B. Apply constructibleSiteComparison to each etale homology object, then transport intrinsic constructibility along this isomorphism and the localization comparison [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Isomorphism invariance transports the local models and the colimit defining each geometric stalk. For vanishing, comparison is additive, so its term in degree q is zero whenever D^q is zero; apply the same middle-term homology vanishing lemma. Combine the termwise, bounded etale, intrinsic proetale, vanishing and comparison-isomorphism clauses to obtain constructibleCoefficientSiteSquare.

The repair (nonempty partitions; for X empty use the one empty stratum with the 0 module) adds no hypothesis and weakens nothing the citer uses; def-constructible-stratification correctly added to stmt_deps. Steps: (1) finite presentation by listing elements, plus exact sheafification and exact u^{-1}/nu^* with the ring identifications -> constants preserved; (2) sheafification tensor comparison with locally bijective unit via the iso criterion; presheaf tensor is constant M(x)_A B, finite, B-linear; (3) algebraic inverse-image tensor comparison on F and B_X. Small point: the AlgebraicInverseImage instantiation of étale u^{-1} is routine from prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (2); accepted. (4) same strata and covers give M(x)_A B; (5) comparison-pullback twice, étale cover is pro-étale, encoding/constructibility bridge for any finite B and global partition, empty case handled; (6) thm-constructible-serre kernel then cokernel of C^{q-1}->Z^q = H^q; (7) lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact (3). This matches Stacks 0GKB (proof omitted, same-stratification hint), 03RZ(3), and main-20261015 sk-thm-pe-constructible-comparison-equivalence (1)-(2), forward direction only. No SGA. Edge cases: X empty, B=0, A=B, Z/4->Z/2 underived, a=b, zero complex. DAG search found no duplicate: the classical/converse, surjective change-of-ring, derived condensed scalar-extension and O_E->E nodes all differ. 11 generic tool_uses accepted; all three Mathlib search kinds recorded; steps under 2000 chars.
